notes.title: Several bug fixes
notes.content:
[h1]List of changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug which in most cases did not display the "Accelerate text" button for already known texts.

[*] Fixed a bug that did not correctly reset the "Oldschool Mode" when restarting.

[*] Fixed a bug that allowed collected items to be kept beyond death.
[/list]

Wrongly displayed texts and other errors have been fixed.
